evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Framing a known production failure as something to reproduce carries low-arousal, mildly negative valence — weariness with a recurring defect, not alarm.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Imperative 'must' twice over registers urgency-as-demand — high arousal, negative valence oriented toward preventing failure.
